St. Andrew Outpatient Clinic

Last updated on October 9th, 2026.

Outpatient clinic: free health care

Belleplaine, St. Andrew

Get directions (opens in a new tab) Call Maurice Byer Polyclinic

In an emergency

Go to the Queen Elizabeth Hospital’s Accident and Emergency Department, which is open 24 hours a day.

Services
